entities.justification: Identified by context as the city ('eius Civitatis', 'fontanam Civitatis') where the Halych Suburb and municipal fountain are located.
Mentioned as 'Suburbium eius Civitatis Haliciense nuncupatum'.
Agricultural plot described as 'laneum Szethowski dictum penes Szethowski laneum post fontanam Civitatis situ'.
A woman mentioned as proving her entitlement to a portion of the Szethowski laneus ('praedictae Felsztynowie se habere').
Referred to by the council's standard self-designation 'praeallegato Officio nostri'.
